description: Percent promo discount is rounded down (Math.floor) instead of to the nearest cent
Free standard shipping threshold uses > instead of >= (an order of exactly $50.00 pays shipping)
Order detail view: total shows the subtotal (discount and shipping ignored)
Cart view: line total shows the unit price (copy-paste from the price column)
Open redirect: protocol-relative targets (//host) are accepted after login
Catalog counter shows the number of products on the current page instead of the total
Low-stock threshold is exclusive: a stock of exactly 5 shows "In stock"
A promo code is rejected when the subtotal equals the minimum order exactly (<= instead of <)
Order status transition shipped → cancelled is allowed
Order history shows the raw status code instead of its label
